summary_1line: Krishna and the Pandavas visit Bhishma on his bed of arrows, where Krishna praises Bhishma’s wisdom and asks him to instruct grieving Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows by the river Oghavati, surrounded by sages and warriors while Krishna and the Pandavas approach reverently.
Krishna stands beside the arrow‑pierced Bhishma, speaking solemnly while the Pandavas sit around the dying grandsire.
The aged Bhishma slightly raises his head from the arrow-bed and folds his hands in devotion while addressing Krishna.
